instructions: See docs/ratings.md. Give every season a rating on the absolute scale. Rate the player that season, never their career.

seasons.note: Six years as an understudy and then a genuine run in the side. A better goalkeeper at thirty-one than he had been as Given’s deputy.
Twenty-five and, by common consent, the best goalkeeper in the world; four points above the thirty-five-year-old of the 2013/14 row.
A quick, relentless screening midfielder with an Ivory Coast first-team place; no goals and no assists in three Spurs seasons is the whole picture of his game.
Ten goals from the left and, until Christmas, the best player in the league; the move to City the following summer was priced off this season.
Nine assists in a title-winning side, but in and out of the team and never quite the player he was in the first half of 2010/11.
A first-choice midfielder in a side that qualified for the Champions League; the range of passing and the shooting were top-flight, the lack of mobility always the price.
Two starts in the title season; injury, not a fall in level.
Ever-present at 32 for a relegated Norwich; a decade on from the earlier rows and barely changed as a footballer.
Seventeen and already extraordinarily quick, but a long way from a finished footballer.
Nineteen years old and twenty-nine starts, which is remarkable; rated as the teenager, not the Spain international he became.
